note: Hand-written question specifications for protocol v2. Every phrasing is used once. Subjects and records are assigned by a seeded draw (corpus.questions), not chosen by the author; expected evidence is derived from the generator's intended labels. Hedged questions ('might', 'may', 'perhaps') count records with the signal PRESENT as the answer.
